L67@P2: Wrap-around services, empowering Veterans at risk of, or experiencing
L68@P2: homelessness, to achieve permanent housing
L69@P2: in a stable environment.
L70@P2: At Insight Housing, we believe that housing is a human right, and that solving
L71@P2: homelessness requires more than just a roof. We provide comprehensive services to
L72@P2: meet people where they are and help them build a pathway forward.

L75@P2: Ensuring everyone in our community has a home through supportive and
L76@P2: sustainable housing solutions.
L77@P2: Vision
L78@P2: We envision a world where everyone has food and housing security in a caring
L79@P2: community that they call home.

L94@P3: Insight Housing supports seven counties across northern California. Working

L100@P4: Home Improvement
L101@P4: at Russell Street
L102@P4: In October 2024, we continued to
L103@P4: make our programs feel like home
L104@P4: with the help of a Lowe’s Home
L105@P4: Improvement grant.
L106@P4: Over 50 volunteers came out to our
L107@P4: Russell Street residence to revamp
L108@P4: all of the outdoor spaces on the
L109@P4: property and remodel a kitchen in
L110@P4: just three days. A highlight of this
L111@P4: project was the addition of three
L112@P4: planter boxes to the backyard,
L113@P4: which residents now tend. Staff use
L114@P4: this sustainable food source weekly
L115@P4: to cook for residents in the Board
L116@P4: and Care program.
L117@P4: Gratitude at the
L118@P4: Hope Center
L119@P4: Every November, our daily free
L120@P4: Community Meal at the Hope Center
L121@P4: gets a Thanksgiving twist for a day.
L122@P4: This year, chef Andre and his team
L123@P4: served up a festive feast of turkey,
L124@P4: ham, potatoes, pie, and all the other
L125@P4: holiday favorites to our residents
L126@P4: and Berkeley neighbors.
L127@P4: Over 250 people from all
L128@P4: throughout the community joined
L129@P4: us for the delicious meal and a
L130@P4: chance to connect.
L131@P4: As the fiscal year continued, we set
L132@P4: a new record for meals served,
L133@P4: providing a total of 139,000 meals
L134@P4: to those in need!
L135@P4: Planning for the Future
L136@P4: We launched our new three-year
L137@P4: strategic plan 2025–2028, which
L138@P4: will help us meet the needs of our
L139@P4: neighbors and lead the way in
L140@P4: innovative housing solutions.
L141@P4: Our four key strategic priorities
L142@P4: are expanding real estate
L143@P4: development, responsibly growing
L144@P4: programs throughout the region,
L145@P4: broadening our policy influence,
L146@P4: and strengthening our infrastructure
L147@P4: and talent systems.
L148@P4: CEO Calleene Egan shared this
L149@P4: plan to all of Insight Housing’s staff,
L150@P4: and we celebrated the launch of
L151@P4: this new era!
L152@P4: A New Home
L153@P4: After temporarily relocating to
L154@P4: Emeryville, the Women’s Overnight
L155@P4: Shelter officially reopened in our
L156@P4: newly renovated Dwight Way
L157@P4: building in May. The refreshed
L158@P4: space offers 32 women’s beds, and
L159@P4: features a brand-new shared
L160@P4: kitchen, a welcoming community
L161@P4: room, and private spaces to meet
L162@P4: with case managers and access
L163@P4: other services.
L164@P4: The updated shelter provides
L165@P4: women with a safe, supportive
L166@P4: home where they can begin to heal
L167@P4: and take important next steps
L168@P4: toward stability. In addition to the
L169@P4: Women’s Shelter, Dwight Way will
L170@P4: also include 26 Veterans
L171@P4: Transitional Housing beds and 15
L172@P4: Board and Care beds, with residents
L173@P4: expected to move in within the next
L174@P4-5: fiscal year. 4,880

L196@P6: By 2035, Insight Housing will expand access to stable, permanent homes
L197@P6: across at least seven Northern California counties. We will develop, own, and
L198@P6: manage these properties ourselves, using a mix of public and missionaligned funding to keep them deeply affordable.
L199@P6: The insights and perspectives of residents will guide every aspect of our work,
L200@P6: from building design and on-site support services to the policies we advance.
L201@P6: Inside the organization, we will build a strong, diverse leadership pipeline,
L202@P6: with half of all leadership roles filled internally, and use real-time dashboards
L203@P6: to track financial health, and resident outcomes.
L204@P6: Through steady, resident-informed work, we envision a future where
L205@P6: homelessness across Northern California is rare, brief, and non-recurring.
